emma: Quick prereq for tomorrow's launch post — can runtime run a focused sanity benchmark on the final quant profile and confirm lead webhook routing to CRM sandbox? Need p50/p95 tokens/s, coldstart heatmap, per-request latencies CSV, and a simple line if any requests failed routing. Use model rdlw-7b-quant-a01 (final), warmup 30@300 tokens, concurrency 10, batch-cap 16. Route to wf-demo-02 (SFDC sandbox). Need artifacts within 5h if possible.
aj: We can do a spotprobe. Confirming model tag rdlw-7b-quant-a01, warmup 30@300, concurrency 10, batch-cap 16, cold-sweep yes? Which region for Dedicated routing?
emma: Yes cold-sweep. Use dedicated-us-west. Also scrub PII in logs. Please annotate traces with webhook=wf-demo-02.
rob: Suggested command:
```
spotprobe --model rdlw-7b-quant-a01 --prompts webinar-pack --warmup 30 --tokens 300 --concurrency 10 --batch-cap 16 --cold-sweep 20 --annot webhook=wf-demo-02
```
Outputs: metrics-summary.txt (p50/p95, token-cost), latencies.csv, coldstart-heatmap.png, routing-sample.json (headers masked), anomalies.txt if any fallbacks.
bench-bot: Job scheduled: spotprobe-1765551234-main on node-d12 (quantized)  ETA ~3h. Link: https://jobs.redwood/spotprobe/1765551234 :robot_face:
aj: Starting now. Will post artifacts and one-line slide-friendly summary (3 bullets) here when done. If any request falls back to rdlw-7b-fp16 I'll call it out with request ids.
sarah: Thanks team  Please ping me immediately if p95 exceeds 900ms or routing shows >1% failures. :eyes:
